description: This file defines the BasketWithItemsSpecification class, which is a specification for querying a Basket entity including its items, based on either a basket ID or a buyer ID.

classes.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification
classes.description: A specification class extending Specification<Basket> to fetch a basket along with its items based on basket ID or buyer ID.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(int basketId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a specification to find a basket by its ID and include its items.

methods.name: BasketWithItemsSpecification(string buyerId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a specification to find a basket by buyer ID and include its items.
